name: Lilt Translator
description: A TMGMT translator plugin that integrates with the Lilt translation service.
project_description:
Back to top 

 Overview 
 Unlock translation with enterprise-grade quality and AI speed directly within Drupal. Streamline your translation workflows with the LILT Connector for Drupal Translation Management Tools (TMGMT). Seamlessly send content for brand-accurate, AI translation, with optional human verification, and automatically receive translated content back into your Drupal platform, ready for publishing. 

 Back to top 

 Features and Benefits 
 
 Seamless TMGMT integration: Effortlessly push content from your Drupal TMGMT interface to LILT for translation and pull completed translations back into Drupal for publishing. 
 Flexible translation workflows: Choose between AI-only translation for speed and scale or human-verified translation for critical content. 
 Real-time progress tracking: Monitor the live status of your translation projects directly within your Drupal TMGMT dashboard. 
 Enterprise-grade security & compliance: LILT adheres to stringent industry certifications (SOC 2, ISO) and offers flexible deployment options to meet the highest security standards. 
 Human-verified quality: Retrain AI with human verifiers, ensuring technical accuracy and reducing translation errors in critical content. 
 Consistent global branding: LLMs are customized for unique company brand voice and preferences, ensuring consistency across all languages. 
 Accelerate time-to-market: LILT’s AI shortens delivery timelines, getting your multilingual content in front of your global audience even faster. 
 
 Back to top 

 Requirements 
 
 The TMGMT module 
 An active LILT account / API key 
 
 Back to top 

 Installation/Usage 
 
 1. Install TMGMT and TMGMT LILT Provider modules: These can be installed directly from your Drupal admin interface using their package URLs.

2. Enable the modules: Activate the installed TMGMT and TMGMT LILT Provider modules.

3. Configure the LILT Provider: Enter your LILT API Key in the TMGMT Translation Providers settings.

 
 For detailed instructions, please refer to the README instructions . 

 If you'd like to demo the module, this self-contained docker environment will allow you to demo it with a LILT API key. 

 Visit us online at www.lilt.com or reach out to us at connect@lilt.com to learn more.

 Back to top 

 Development 
 Use the GitHub project for code contributions, bug reports, feature requests, etc. If you'd like to contribute to the module, you can use this project as a self-contained development environment.

 Back to top 

 About LILT 
 LILT empowers organizations to scale and optimize global content. Our platform combines advanced AI technology with a human quality guarantee, ensuring unparalleled accuracy, speed, and scale. Partner with LILT to improve translation quality, automate workflows, and scale your reach.
